title: Stupor
summary: STUPOR, noun [Latin] 1. Great diminution or suspension of sensibility; suppression of sense; numbness; as the stupor of a limb. 2. Intellectual insensibility; moral stupidity; heedlessness or inattent

inlines.v: STUPOR, noun [Latin] 1. Great diminution or suspension of sensibility; suppression of sense; numbness; as the stupor of a limb. 2. Intellectual insensibility; moral stupidity; heedlessness or inattention to ones interests.
